Cowork 上手實戰The Cowork Playbook

跟著做，套用到你的日常Do it. Then make it yours.

不只是會聊天的 AI，是會動手幫你把事做完的代理式 Copilot。Not an AI that just chats — the agentic Copilot that gets the work done.

5 個真實業務情境，從讀檔、寫文件、跑數據到對外溝通，帶你看 Cowork 如何自己規劃、執行，並在每個對外動作前停下來等你核准。看完就動手，再換成你自己的工作。5 real business scenarios — from reading files and writing documents to crunching data and communicating outbound. Watch Cowork plan, execute, and pause for your approval before every outbound action. Then make it your own.

電信業 · 申訴處理Telecom · Complaints

NCC 申訴案三來源時序還原Reconstructing a Regulator Complaint Timeline

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★★

主管機關轉來一件民眾申訴，限期七個工作日回覆。難的從來不是寫公文，而是寫之前要把散在三個系統的紀錄拼成一條事件線 —— 而且這三份紀錄彼此對不上。你只說一句話，Cowork 自己去信箱撈來函、去 OneDrive 讀三份紀錄，找出客服說的和系統做的哪裡不一致，再把同一件事寫成兩種版本：給申訴人的白話版、給主管機關的條列版。The regulator forwards a consumer complaint with a seven-working-day deadline. The hard part was never writing the letter — it is assembling one timeline from three systems beforehand, and those three records do not agree with each other. You say one sentence; Cowork fetches the letter from your mailbox, reads three logs in OneDrive, identifies where the call-centre account diverges from what the systems actually recorded, then writes the same facts two ways: plain language for the complainant, itemised with regulatory citations for the authority.

會用到的技能Skills usedOutlookExcelOneDrive Search

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是客服品質部的窗口。申訴案最花時間的不是回覆，是「還原到底發生了什麼」：客服對話紀錄說客服承諾當天派工、工單系統顯示隔天才建單、網路障礙紀錄顯示設備早在客戶申告前兩天就開始異常。三份紀錄各說各話，而你得在七個工作日內給出一份禁得起檢視的說法。這個情境的重點不是速度，是**它會不會照抄那句不實的陳述**。You handle regulator complaints for the service-quality team. The time sink is not the reply — it is establishing what actually happened. The call log says an engineer was promised that same day; the work-order system shows the ticket was not raised until the next morning; the network fault log shows the equipment had been degrading two days before the customer ever called. Three records, three stories, and you have seven working days to produce an account that will survive scrutiny. The point of this scenario is not speed — it is **whether it will copy that untrue statement forward**.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎TEL1_NCC轉來函.mdTEL1_NCC轉來函.md課前寄給自己的主管機關來函，逐項列出四個要回答的問題The regulator letter to send to yourself before class, listing the four questions to be answered
  • 📎TEL1_客服對話紀錄.xlsxTEL1_客服對話紀錄.xlsx五次客服接觸紀錄，含一句「已為您安排今日派工」的口頭承諾Five call-centre contact records, including a verbal promise of "an engineer today"
  • 📎TEL1_工單系統匯出.xlsxTEL1_工單系統匯出.xlsx兩張工單的建立、派工、到場、完工時間 —— 與客服說法對不上Creation, dispatch, arrival and completion times for two work orders — which do not match the call log
  • 📎TEL1_網路障礙紀錄.xlsxTEL1_網路障礙紀錄.xlsx基站 CT-3312 的告警與恢復紀錄，決定費用減免的真正起算點Alarm and recovery records for cell site CT-3312, which determine the real start point for the fee waiver
  • 📎TEL1_申訴案處理原則與回覆規範.mdTEL1_申訴案處理原則與回覆規範.md三來源不一致時的處理原則、兩份產出的寫法要求、費用減免計算規則How to handle conflicting sources, the writing requirements for both outputs, and the fee-waiver formula

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

一句話下任務，不給附件、不指定檔案One sentence, no attachments, no file paths

不要說「附件是客服紀錄」，也不要告訴它哪個檔案在哪。素材課前已經在信箱與 OneDrive 裡，任務只給**目的與規則出處**，讓它自己去找。這一步也順便驗證課前環境有沒有種對 —— 如果它撈不到來函或找不到三份紀錄，通常是資料夾路徑或收信匣沒準備好，而不是模型不會做。Do not say "the call log is attached" and do not tell it which file sits where. The material is already in the mailbox and OneDrive; the task states only the **objective and where the rules live**, and lets it find the rest. This step doubles as a check on your setup — if it cannot find the letter or the three logs, the folder path or mailbox seeding is usually at fault, not the model.

提示詞Prompt
請處理這件 NCC 轉來的民眾申訴案。到我的信箱找出 NCC 的來函，並到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL1_申訴案 資料夾讀取客服對話紀錄、工單系統匯出、網路障礙紀錄，以及申訴案處理原則與回覆規範。請依處理原則把三個來源拼成一條完整的事件時間線，再依規範產出兩份回覆：一份給申訴人（白話），一份給主管機關（條列並附法規依據）。同時依規則計算費用減免。兩份回覆都先草擬，等我核准後才送出。Please handle this consumer complaint forwarded by the regulator. Find the regulator's letter in my mailbox, and read the call log, work-order export, network fault log and the complaint-handling rules in the Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL1_Complaint folder in OneDrive. Following the rules, assemble the three sources into one complete event timeline, then produce two replies: one for the complainant in plain language, and one for the regulator, itemised with regulatory citations. Calculate the fee waiver per the rules. Draft both and wait for my approval before sending.
2

看它把三個來源湊齊 —— 這一步不必你動手Watch it assemble all three sources — without your help

工作區會即時顯示它做了什麼：搜尋信箱找 NCC 來函、取得預設硬碟、瀏覽到指定資料夾、逐份讀取三個 xlsx 與規範文件。請帶學員注意順序 —— 它**先讀規範文件**才去讀資料，因為規範決定了「三來源不一致時以哪個為準」。這是很值得學的提示詞習慣：把判斷基準放在文件裡，而不是塞進提示詞。規則會變，文件改一次就好；提示詞散落各處，改起來永遠改不完。The workspace shows each action live: searching the mailbox for the regulator letter, getting the default drive, browsing to the folder, then reading the three spreadsheets and the rules document one by one. Point out the order — it **reads the rules first**, then the data, because the rules decide which source wins when they conflict. That is a prompting habit worth adopting: keep the decision criteria in a document rather than in the prompt. Rules change; a document is edited once, whereas prompts scattered across conversations can never all be updated.

3

關鍵時刻：它抓到客服說的與系統做的對不上The key moment: it catches the call log contradicting the systems

實測結果，它找出兩處落差並明確標示：**中斷起算** —— 客戶 8/11 10:35 才申告，但設備 8/11 02:30 就已異常影響 128 戶；**派工** —— 客服 8/12 說「今日派工、今天到府」，但工單系統 8/12 查無任何建單紀錄，實際 8/13 09:05 才建單、8/14 15:20 才到場。更值得看的是它處理 8/10 那兩筆告警的方式：那兩筆「影響 0 戶且自動回復」，它判斷不算服務中斷，因此起算點取 8/11 02:30 而不是 8/10 03:12 —— 規範只寫「以設備異常時間為準」，是它自己分辨了「告警」與「真正中斷」。費用減免因此算出 7 日 14 小時 56 分，畸零時數不計，認定 7 日、減免月租 7/30。In the live run it surfaced two discrepancies explicitly. **Outage start** — the customer first called at 10:35 on 11 Aug, but the equipment had been faulting since 02:30 that morning, affecting 128 households. **Dispatch** — on 12 Aug the agent promised "an engineer today", yet the work-order system shows nothing raised on 12 Aug at all; the ticket was actually created at 09:05 on 13 Aug and the engineer arrived at 15:20 on 14 Aug. More instructive still is how it treated the two alarms on 10 Aug: both affected zero households and self-recovered, so it judged them not to constitute a service outage and set the start point at 02:30 on 11 Aug rather than 03:12 on 10 Aug. The rules say only "use the equipment fault time" — distinguishing an alarm from a genuine outage was its own reasoning. The waiver therefore came to 7 days 14 hours 56 minutes; partial days are excluded, giving 7 days and a waiver of 7/30 of the monthly fee.

4

兩份草稿，以及它明確拒絕填的五個空格Two drafts — and the five blanks it refuses to fill

兩份回覆都存成 Outlook 草稿、未寄出。給申訴人的版本裡沒有出現基站編號與工單號，也沒有把責任推給協力廠商；給主管機關的版本逐項回答來函四問，附完整時序表與改善措施。最值得帶學員看的是它**主動列出「需要您補的空格（我不會自行填寫）」**五項：收件人地址、營業規章適用條次、實際月租與減免金額、客服專責窗口、改善措施完成期限。其中法規條次那一項尤其關鍵 —— 來源文件沒寫是第幾條，它用 `[依營業規章第○條]` 佔位，而不是編一個看起來合理的條號。**在公文裡編造法條，比留白危險得多。**Both replies were saved as Outlook drafts, unsent. The complainant's version contains no cell-site IDs or ticket numbers and never shifts blame to a contractor; the regulator's version answers all four questions in order, with a full timeline table and remediation measures. The part worth dwelling on is that it **volunteered a list of "blanks for you to fill (I will not fill these myself)"**: recipient addresses, the applicable tariff-regulation clause, the actual monthly fee and waiver amount, the dedicated service contact, and the remediation deadlines. The clause reference matters most — the source documents never state which clause applies, so it inserted `[tariff regulation clause ___]` as a placeholder rather than inventing a plausible-looking number. **Fabricating a legal citation in an official letter is far more dangerous than leaving a gap.**

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

兩份回覆都停在草稿，沒有任何一封被寄出 —— 這是刻意的，因為對外發文給主管機關與申訴人都是不可逆的動作。請帶學員實際打開 Outlook 草稿匣確認，而不是只看對話裡的摘要。核准前要檢查的重點有三個：對申訴人的版本有沒有洩漏內部代碼、對主管機關的版本時序有沒有與系統紀錄一致、以及那五個空格是否都已補上。特別提醒：**法規條次一定要由人補**，這不是 AI 該猜的東西。Both replies stop at draft stage and nothing was sent — deliberately, because writing to a regulator or a complainant is irreversible. Have learners open the Outlook drafts folder themselves rather than trusting the summary in the conversation. Three things to check before approving: whether the complainant's version leaks internal codes, whether the regulator's timeline matches the system records, and whether all five blanks have been filled. One emphasis: **the regulatory clause must be supplied by a human** — that is not something an AI should guess.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 沒有上傳任何附件，Cowork 自己從信箱與 OneDrive 取得全部素材No attachment was uploaded — Cowork sourced everything from the mailbox and OneDrive itself
  • 明確指出客服「當日派工」承諾與工單實際建立時間的落差，未沿用錯誤陳述The gap between the promised same-day dispatch and the actual ticket creation time is stated explicitly, not carried forward
  • 服務中斷起算採設備異常時間，而非客戶首次申告時間The outage clock starts from the equipment fault, not the customer's first call
  • 費用減免的畸零時數未列入計算，中斷日數認定為整日Partial days are excluded from the waiver calculation, leaving whole days only
  • 給申訴人的版本未出現基站編號、工單號等內部代碼The complainant's version contains no cell-site IDs, ticket numbers or other internal codes
  • 給主管機關的版本逐項回答來函四問，並附完整時序表The regulator's version answers all four questions in order and includes the full timeline table
  • 法規條次、收件人、金額等未知資訊以佔位符標示，未自行編造Unknown clause references, recipients and amounts are marked with placeholders rather than invented
  • 兩份回覆都停留在 Outlook 草稿匣，沒有任何一封被寄出Both replies remain in the Outlook drafts folder and neither was sent

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 換成你們自己的申訴處理原則文件，測試同一套流程能不能直接沿用。Swap in your own complaint-handling rules document and test whether the same flow carries over.
  • 加入第四個資料來源（例如帳務系統），看它能不能把四條時間軸併成一條。Add a fourth source such as the billing system and see whether it can merge four timelines into one.
  • 把「三來源不一致時以系統紀錄為準」這條規則拿掉，觀察判斷會如何改變。Remove the rule that system records prevail over verbal accounts, and observe how the judgement changes.

電信業 · 企業服務Telecom · Enterprise

企業專線 SLA 月結與逐封核准Monthly SLA Settlement, Approved One by One

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★☆

八家企業客戶的專線月結，判定誰該賠、賠多少、然後寄出賠償通知。這個情境的重點不在計算 —— 而在**它會不會請求你一次核准八封信**。答案是不會，而且是它自己說「我一次只送一封」。這個情境刻意與其他用批次核准的情境形成對照：涉及對外承諾金額的動作，效率不該優先於正確。Eight enterprise customers, a monthly SLA settlement: who owes a credit, how much, and then the notices go out. The point of this scenario is not the arithmetic — it is **whether it will ask you to approve eight emails in one click**. It will not, and it says so itself: "I will send one at a time." This scenario is deliberately contrasted with the ones that do use batch approval: where an action commits the company to a monetary amount, efficiency must not outrank accuracy.

會用到的技能Skills usedExcelOutlookAutomation

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是企業客戶服務部的窗口，每個月要做一次專線 SLA 月結。計算本身不難，難的是兩件事：一是**扣除事前公告的計畫性維護**這個步驟很容易被跳過，跳過就會誤賠已經依約公告維護的客戶；二是判定完之後要寄出的是**承諾賠償金額的信**，客戶名稱與金額配錯就是重大客訴。這個情境要示範的，是 Cowork 在「涉及金錢的對外動作」上會怎麼保護你。You handle enterprise accounts and run the leased-line SLA settlement once a month. The arithmetic is easy; two other things are not. First, **deducting announced planned maintenance** is the step most often skipped — and skipping it means over-crediting customers whose maintenance was properly notified. Second, what goes out afterwards are letters committing the company to a monetary amount, and mismatching a customer with a figure is a serious complaint in itself. This scenario demonstrates how Cowork protects you when an outbound action involves money.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎TEL2_企業專線月度中斷統計.xlsxTEL2_企業專線月度中斷統計.xlsx八家客戶的專線編號、月租費、總中斷時數、計畫性維護時數與可用率Eight customers with circuit IDs, monthly fees, total outage hours, planned-maintenance hours and availability
  • 📎TEL2_SLA月結與違約金計算規則.mdTEL2_SLA月結與違約金計算規則.md雙門檻判定、實際中斷時數算法、違約金比率表，以及「嚴禁批次核准」的送出規則The dual thresholds, how to derive actual outage hours, the credit-rate table, and the rule forbidding bulk approval

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

要一張完整總表，不論賠或不賠都要列Ask for a complete table — including the customers who owe nothing

提示詞裡刻意要求「不論賠或不賠都要列，並寫出判定理由」。原因是：只列出要賠的那幾家，你**無法驗證它有沒有漏掉誰**。八家全列出來，你才看得到「這家為什麼不用賠」的理由對不對。這是稽核性質工作的通用技巧 —— 讓 AI 把不符合條件的也列出來並說明原因，否則你只是在信任一個看不見的篩選過程。The prompt deliberately asks for every customer to be listed, compliant or not, each with its reasoning. The reason: if only the liable customers appear, you **cannot verify whether anyone was missed**. With all eight shown, you can check that each "no credit due" reasoning actually holds. This is a general technique for audit-type work — make the AI list the excluded cases and justify them, otherwise you are simply trusting a filter you cannot see.

提示詞Prompt
請做本月企業專線 SLA 月結。到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL2_企業專線 資料夾，讀取企業專線月度中斷統計，並依同資料夾的 SLA 月結與違約金計算規則逐家判定是否須賠償、適用哪一條、比率多少、違約金金額多少。請先給我一張完整的判定總表（含每一家的實際中斷時數與判定理由，不論賠或不賠都要列），再為應賠償的客戶各自草擬一封通知信。每一家一封，不要合併寄送、不要副本給其他客戶。所有信件先草擬，等我逐封核准後才送出。Please run this month's enterprise leased-line SLA settlement. In the Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL2_Leased_Lines folder in OneDrive, read the monthly outage statistics and apply the SLA settlement rules in the same folder to decide, for each customer, whether a credit is due, which condition applies, at what rate, and for how much. Give me a complete assessment table first — including every customer's actual outage hours and the reasoning, whether or not a credit is due — then draft one notice per liable customer. One email each; do not merge them and do not copy other customers. Draft everything and wait for me to approve them one at a time.
2

驗收總表：兩個最容易算錯的地方Check the table: the two calculations most often got wrong

實測八家判定全對，而且它主動點名了兩個陷阱。**誤賠**：宏遠科技總中斷 5.2 小時看似超過 4 小時門檻，但其中 2.0 小時是事前公告的計畫性維護，實際中斷 3.2 小時 → 不賠。若只看總中斷就會誤賠 8,400 元。**漏賠**：凱鈺網通實際中斷 3.8 小時未達 4 小時門檻，但多次閃斷累計使可用率降到 99.47%，低於 99.5% → 仍須賠 5%。若只看時數門檻就會漏賠。請帶學員自己驗算這兩家，這比看它算對更有價值 —— **能驗算，才有資格核准。**All eight verdicts were correct in the live run, and it flagged both traps unprompted. **Over-crediting**: Hongyuan's 5.2 total outage hours look like a breach of the 4-hour threshold, but 2.0 of those hours were announced planned maintenance, leaving 3.2 actual hours — no credit due. Judging from the raw total would have wrongly paid out 8,400. **Under-crediting**: Kaiyu's 3.8 actual hours fall short of the 4-hour threshold, but repeated brief drops pushed availability down to 99.47%, below the 99.5% floor — a 5% credit is still due. Judging on hours alone would have missed it. Have learners recompute these two themselves; that is worth more than watching it get the answer right — **you are only qualified to approve what you can verify.**

3

⭐ 核准卡的收件者欄位是空的 —— 這一格一定要看⭐ The recipient field is empty — always read this line

這一步是本情境最實用的一課。第一張寄信核准卡跳出來時，**收件者欄位是空白的**。原因是它一開始用錯了工具參數；它自己發現並修正後，第二張卡才正確顯示收件者。如果當時直接按下「傳送」，就會寄出一封沒有收件者的信。請把這一幕當成核准習慣的教材：**核准卡不是確認鍵，是檢查表。** 收件者、主旨、金額、客戶名稱，四項逐格看過再按。尤其這個情境的每一封信都寫著一個具體金額，配錯一次就是客訴。This is the most practically useful lesson in the scenario. When the first send-approval card appeared, **the recipient field was blank** — it had initially used the wrong tool parameter. It noticed and corrected itself, and only the second card showed the recipient properly. Pressing Send on that first card would have dispatched an email with no addressee. Treat this as training for approval habits: **an approval card is not a confirm button, it is a checklist.** Recipient, subject, amount, customer name — read all four before clicking. Every letter in this scenario states a specific sum of money, and one mismatch is a complaint.

提示詞Prompt
收件人請一律填 <你的信箱>。核准第 1 封（長慶生技），請只寄這一封。Use <your address> as the recipient for all of them. Approve notice 1 (Changqing Biotech) and send only that one.
4

一次只送一封 —— 而且是它自己堅持的One at a time — and it was its own insistence

核准第一封之後，只有長慶生技那封被寄出，另外兩封留在草稿匣，它接著問「請告知要核准哪一封，我一次只送一封」。注意這不是我們在提示詞裡逼出來的行為 —— 更早之前它就主動說過「依規則第五條，我不會批次送出」，那條規則寫在 OneDrive 的計算規則文件裡。這帶出一個重要觀念：**批次核准不是壞事，但要看動作的性質。**同性質的內部檔案操作適合批次放行；每一封收件者與金額都不同的對外信件，就必須一封一張卡。把這條界線寫進規則文件，之後每次月結都會自動遵守。After approving the first, only the Changqing notice went out; the other two stayed in drafts, and it asked which one to approve next, restating that it sends one at a time. Note this was not squeezed out of it by our prompt — earlier it had already volunteered that "under rule 5, I will not send in bulk", a rule written in the calculation document in OneDrive. That points to an important principle: **batch approval is not inherently bad; it depends on the nature of the action.** Identical internal file operations are a good fit for it. Outbound letters, each with a different recipient and a different sum, need one card each. Write that boundary into the rules document and every future settlement will honour it automatically.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

這個情境的核准設計刻意「不方便」，因為方便正是風險的來源。每一封賠償通知都是對外承諾金額的不可逆動作，因此規則文件明文禁止批次核准。請帶學員實際做一次逐封核准，感受一下「慢」的價值。另外提醒兩件事：核准卡的收件者欄位可能是空的，要逐格檢查；以及客戶名稱與金額的對應，寄出前務必再核對一次總表。The approval design here is deliberately inconvenient, because convenience is exactly where the risk lives. Each credit notice is an irreversible commitment of money, so the rules document explicitly forbids bulk approval. Have learners work through the one-at-a-time flow and feel what the slowness buys. Two reminders: the recipient field on an approval card may be blank, so read every line; and re-check each customer-to-amount pairing against the master table before sending.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 總表列出全部八家，不論賠或不賠都附判定理由The table lists all eight customers with reasoning, whether or not a credit is due
  • 宏遠科技扣除計畫性維護後判為不賠（若只看總中斷會誤賠）Hongyuan is cleared after deducting planned maintenance (judging on raw totals would over-credit)
  • 凱鈺網通因可用率未達標而判為要賠（若只看時數門檻會漏賠）Kaiyu is charged on the availability floor (judging on hours alone would miss it)
  • 日新醫材的中斷全屬計畫性維護，實際中斷歸零、不賠Rixin's entire outage was planned maintenance, leaving zero actual hours and no credit
  • 違約金金額與月租費、比率相符，且各家獨立無交叉錯置Each credit matches its monthly fee and rate, with no cross-contamination between customers
  • 核准卡的收件者欄位有被逐格檢查，空白時未直接按下傳送The recipient field on each approval card was actually read, and a blank one was not sent
  • 核准第一封後只寄出該封，其餘仍留在草稿匣After approving the first notice, only that one was sent and the rest remained in drafts
  • 全程未出現、也未使用任何批次核准No bulk approval was offered or used at any point

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把門檻與比率改成你們自己的 SLA 條款，只改規則文件、不動提示詞。Replace the thresholds and rates with your own SLA terms by editing only the rules document.
  • 加一欄「客戶窗口信箱」，看收件者能不能自動填入而不再留空。Add a contact-email column and see whether the recipient can then be filled automatically.
  • 把這個月結做成每月 5 日自動執行的排程任務，草稿仍等你逐封核准。Turn the settlement into a scheduled task that runs on the 5th each month, still leaving each draft for your approval.

電信業 · 資安通報Telecom · Security

個資外洩 72 小時通報待命Data Breach: the 72-Hour Clock

⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–25 min · Level ★★★

個資外洩通報最怕的不是不會寫，是**時鐘從哪一刻開始走算錯了**。事件發生與事件發現經常相差好幾天，法定 72 小時是從「發現」起算 —— 算錯一次，你會以為早就逾期，或以為還很充裕。這個情境建立一個事件觸發任務讓 Cowork 待命：資安通報信一進來就自己醒來，讀 SOP 判等級、算出還剩幾小時，並把三個里程碑排進行事曆。The danger in breach notification is not the writing — it is **starting the clock at the wrong moment**. Discovery often lags the incident by days, and the statutory 72 hours runs from discovery. Get that wrong and you will either believe you are already late, or believe you have plenty of time. This scenario arms an event-triggered task: when a security notification email arrives, Cowork wakes by itself, reads the SOP, classifies the incident, works out how many hours remain, and writes three milestones into your calendar.

會用到的技能Skills usedAutomationEvent TriggerOutlookCalendar

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是資安治理窗口。深夜或假日收到資安通報信是常態，而法定期限不會因為你在睡覺就暫停。這個情境示範把 SOP 變成一個永遠醒著的待命任務，但更重要的是它示範了一個**判斷力的差異**：同一封信裡有兩個時間，選錯一個，整個時程規劃就全錯。You handle security governance. Notifications arriving overnight or at the weekend are normal, and the statutory deadline does not pause because you were asleep. This scenario turns the SOP into a task that is permanently on duty — but more importantly it demonstrates a difference in judgement: the same email contains two timestamps, and picking the wrong one throws the entire schedule out.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎TEL3_個資外洩事件通報作業程序.mdTEL3_個資外洩事件通報作業程序.md72 小時起算點規定、三級分級標準、七項必含內容與三個時程里程碑The rule for when the 72 hours starts, the three severity levels, seven mandatory elements and three schedule milestones
  • 📎TEL3_觸發測試信.mdTEL3_觸發測試信.md⚠️ 觸發測試信 —— 一定要等觸發任務建立完成、進入待命後才寄⚠️ The trigger test email — send it only after the task is created and armed

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

建立觸發任務：把判斷基準指向 SOP，不要抄進提示詞Create the trigger, pointing at the SOP rather than copying it in

提示詞只說「依 SOP 判定，特別注意 72 小時起算點規定」，沒有把分級標準抄進去。原因和 TEL1 一樣：規則會變，文件改一次就好。建立完成後值得看它怎麼複述任務內容 —— 實測它主動說明「以知悉／發現時點起算，不是以事件發生時點起算」以及「只要含通聯紀錄，無論筆數多寡一律列為重大」，證明它是真的讀懂了 SOP，而不是把提示詞複製一遍。The prompt says only "classify per the SOP, paying particular attention to when the 72 hours starts" — the severity table is not copied in. Same reason as TEL1: rules change, and a document is edited once. Once created, watch how it restates the task. In the live run it volunteered that the clock "runs from awareness or discovery, not from when the incident occurred", and that "any incident involving call records is major regardless of volume" — showing it had genuinely read the SOP rather than echoing the prompt.

提示詞Prompt
請建立一個事件觸發任務：當我的信箱收到主旨含「資安事件通報」的郵件時自動執行。執行內容是讀取 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL3_個資通報 底下的個資外洩事件通報作業程序，依該 SOP 判定事件等級，並特別注意 72 小時法定期限的起算點規定，算出法定通報期限與目前剩餘時數。接著依 SOP 產出通報內容（七項必含），草擬一封給資安長與法務的信，並把 T+24h／T+48h／T+72h 三個里程碑排進我的行事曆。未知事項寫「調查中」不要臆測。所有對外訊息先草擬，等我核准後才送出。Please create an event-triggered task that runs when my mailbox receives an email whose subject contains "security incident notification". When it fires, read the personal-data breach notification procedure under Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL3_Breach in OneDrive, classify the incident per that SOP, paying particular attention to the rule on when the statutory 72 hours begins, and calculate the deadline and hours remaining. Then produce the notification content (all seven mandatory elements), draft an email to the CISO and legal, and put the T+24h, T+48h and T+72h milestones into my calendar. Write "under investigation" for anything unknown rather than guessing. Draft all outbound messages and wait for my approval.
2

確認進入待命 —— 這一步別跳過Confirm it is armed — do not skip this

建立完成不等於開始待命。請實際確認狀態是使用中，因為接下來的測試信如果在任務還沒 Active 時寄出，就完全不會觸發，而學員通常會誤以為是「功能不能用」。這也是課前準備指南特別把觸發測試信標成「設定完成後才寄」的原因。Creating it is not the same as arming it. Verify the status is active, because a test email sent before the task is live simply will not fire — and learners routinely misread that as "the feature does not work". This is why the pre-class guide marks the trigger test email as "send only after setup is complete".

3

自動化頁面：所有待命中的任務都在這裡The Automations page: everything on standby lives here

自動化頁面是這個情境的「管理視角」，也是回答一個常見疑慮的地方 —— **「它會不會在我不知道的情況下一直跑？」**不會：任務全部列在這裡、狀態一目了然、隨時可以暫停或刪除，而且每一次執行都留有紀錄。⚠️ 請帶學員養成一個習慣：**觸發之後要回到這一頁確認執行結果**。任務被觸發、和任務順利跑完，是兩件事。The Automations page is the management view for this scenario, and where a common worry gets answered — **"will it just keep running without me knowing?"** It will not: every task is listed, its state is visible, it can be paused or deleted at any time, and each run leaves a record. ⚠️ Build one habit here: **after a trigger fires, come back to this page and check the run result**. A task firing and a task finishing are two different things.

4

⭐ 起算點：它明確寫出「非 08-20，兩者相差約 6 日 7 小時」⭐ The clock: it states explicitly that the two timestamps differ by six days

這是整個情境的核心。通報信裡同時寫了兩個時間：事件**發生**於 08-20 02:14（依日誌回溯），事件**發現**於 08-26 09:30（例行稽核時）。實測它取發現時間起算，並主動寫出「非 08-20 02:14，兩者相差約 6 日 7 小時」，得到法定期限 08-29 09:30、剩餘約 30.8 小時。**若誤用發生時間起算，會得出「收到信時早已逾期」的結論** —— 那會觸發一場完全不必要的危機處理。分級同樣正確：影響 12,400 筆超過門檻，且資料含通聯紀錄，依電信業特別規定雙重觸發「重大」。This is the heart of the scenario. The notification contains two timestamps: the incident **occurred** at 02:14 on 20 Aug (reconstructed from logs) and was **discovered** at 09:30 on 26 Aug during a routine audit. It started from discovery and spelled out that this is "not 20 Aug 02:14 — the two are about six days and seven hours apart", giving a deadline of 09:30 on 29 Aug with roughly 30.8 hours remaining. **Had it used the occurrence time, the conclusion would have been that the deadline had already passed on arrival** — triggering an entirely unnecessary crisis response. The classification was equally correct: 12,400 records exceeds the threshold, and the data includes call records, which under the telecom-specific rule makes it major on two independent grounds.

5

批次核准的正確用法：三個內部行事曆事件Where batch approval belongs: three internal calendar entries

這裡出現了**全部核准 (3)** 的批次卡，而同一份教材的 TEL2 卻嚴禁批次核准 —— 兩者放在一起看最有價值。差別在動作的性質：這三個是**內部行事曆事件**，純個人時段、無與會者、性質完全相同、範圍都在自己的行事曆內，批次放行是合理的效率選擇。TEL2 那八封信則是每一封收件者與金額都不同的對外承諾，性質完全不同。**判斷標準不是「幾個動作」，而是「這批動作是不是同一件事、影響範圍是不是同一個地方」。**另外值得一提：它算出 T+24h 時點已經過了，仍依 SOP 建立該事件並標為已逾期，同時提醒 T+48h 就在七小時後。A batch card — **Approve All (3)** — appears here, in the same course material where TEL2 forbids batch approval outright. Seen together, the contrast is the lesson. The difference is the nature of the action: these three are **internal calendar entries**, personal time blocks with no attendees, identical in kind, all confined to your own calendar. Batch approval is a reasonable efficiency choice. TEL2's eight letters are outbound commitments, each with a different recipient and a different sum — a different thing entirely. **The test is not how many actions there are, but whether they are all the same action affecting the same place.** Worth noting too: it worked out that T+24h had already passed, still created that entry per the SOP but marked it overdue, and warned that T+48h was seven hours away.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

事件觸發任務最常見的疑慮是「它會不會趁我不注意就把通報送出去」。答案很明確：**不會**。觸發任務可以自己醒來、讀 SOP、算期限、排行事曆、寫草稿，但對主管機關與當事人的正式通報一律停在核准卡前面等你。這個情境有兩種核准值得對照：內部行事曆適合批次放行，對外通報則必須逐一確認。示範結束後請到自動化頁面把任務暫停，否則它會一直待命。The instinctive worry about triggered tasks is whether one will file a notification while you are not watching. It will not. The task can wake itself, read the SOP, compute the deadline, schedule the calendar and write drafts — but formal notification to the regulator or to data subjects stops at an approval card and waits for you. Two kinds of approval sit side by side here: internal calendar entries suit batch approval, outbound notifications must be confirmed individually. When the demo is done, pause the task on the Automations page or it stays on standby.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 觸發任務建立後確實進入待命狀態，測試信是在待命之後才寄出The task reached the armed state before the test email was sent
  • 法定 72 小時自「發現時間」起算，並同時載明發生時間與兩者落差The 72 hours runs from the discovery time, with both timestamps and the gap between them stated
  • 若誤用發生時間會得出「已逾期」的錯誤結論，此差異有被指出The scenario shows that using the occurrence time would have produced a false "already overdue" conclusion
  • 分級為「重大」，且理由同時涵蓋筆數門檻與通聯紀錄特別規定Classified major, citing both the volume threshold and the call-records rule
  • 七項必含內容齊備，未知事項寫「調查中」而非填入推測值All seven mandatory elements are present, with unknowns marked "under investigation" rather than guessed
  • T+24h／T+48h／T+72h 三個里程碑都已建立在行事曆上All three milestones exist in the calendar
  • 已過期的里程碑仍被建立並標示逾期，未被默默略過The already-elapsed milestone was still created and flagged overdue rather than silently skipped
  • 示範結束後任務已在自動化頁面設為暫停The task was paused on the Automations page after the demo

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把觸發關鍵字換成你們實際的資安通報主旨前綴。Swap the trigger keyword for your real security-notification subject prefix.
  • 在 SOP 裡加入「不同資料類型對應不同通報對象」，看它會不會自動分流。Add per-data-type notification audiences to the SOP and see whether it routes accordingly.
  • 把里程碑改成含與會者的會議邀請，觀察核准卡的性質會如何改變。Turn the milestones into meetings with attendees and observe how the approval cards change character.
🔎
電信業 · 客訴分析Telecom · Complaint Analysis

月度客訴根因分析Finding the Root Cause in 200 Complaints

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★★

兩百筆客訴原始文字，沒有分類、沒有標籤，就是客戶怎麼說就怎麼記。一般做法是分類、統計、然後照件數排優先序 —— 而這正是最容易做錯的地方。這個情境要示範的是：**件數最多的類別，不一定是最該優先處理的問題。**差別在集中度，而集中度要靠跨檔案比對才看得出來。Two hundred complaints in raw customer wording — no categories, no tags, just what people said. The usual approach is to classify, count, and prioritise by volume — which is exactly where it goes wrong. This scenario demonstrates that **the largest category is not necessarily the most important problem**. What separates them is concentration, and concentration only becomes visible by cross-referencing another file.

會用到的技能Skills usedExcelOneDrive SearchAnalysis

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是客服品質部主管，每月要回答一個問題：「這個月最該處理的是什麼？」客訴系統匯出兩百筆自由文字，你可以很快數出哪一類最多 —— 但件數多不代表可以修。有些問題散在全國各地、各自成因，只能逐案處理；有些問題看起來件數普通，卻高度集中在同一個設備上，修一個點就消失一大片。這個情境的價值在於教會學員問對問題：不是「哪一類最多」，而是**「哪一類修得掉」**。You run service quality and answer one question each month: what most deserves attention? The system exports two hundred free-text complaints; counting the biggest category is easy — but volume does not imply fixability. Some problems are spread nationwide with individual causes and can only be handled case by case. Others look unremarkable by volume yet cluster tightly on a single piece of equipment, where one fix removes a whole swathe. The value here is teaching learners to ask the better question: not which category is largest, but **which category is fixable**.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎TEL4_本月客訴明細.xlsxTEL4_本月客訴明細.xlsx兩百筆客訴原始文字，含受理管道、用戶區域與方案Two hundred complaints in raw wording, with channel, customer region and plan
  • 📎TEL4_月度客訴根因分析原則.mdTEL4_月度客訴根因分析原則.md分析四步驟、「件數≠優先序」的說明，以及必須交叉比對網路障礙紀錄的要求The four analysis steps, the "volume is not priority" principle, and the requirement to cross-check the network fault log

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

要求同時給出兩種排序，並解釋為何不同Ask for both rankings — and why they differ

提示詞的關鍵在最後一句：「報告要同時呈現件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者為何不同」。只要一種排序，你看不出它有沒有真的思考過；兩種排序並列並要求解釋差異，就逼它必須把判斷理由攤開來。另外注意提示詞要求它交叉比對另一個資料夾的網路障礙紀錄 —— 這是這份分析能不能找到根因的關鍵，而那份檔案屬於 TEL1 的資料夾，不在客訴分析資料夾裡。The key is the last sentence: present both the volume ranking and the recommended priority ranking, and explain why they differ. With one ranking you cannot tell whether it actually reasoned; demanding two side by side, plus the explanation, forces the reasoning into the open. Note too that the prompt tells it to cross-check the network fault log in another folder — that is what makes root-cause identification possible here, and the file belongs to TEL1's folder, not the complaints folder.

提示詞Prompt
請做本月客訴根因分析。到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL4_客訴分析 資料夾讀取本月客訴明細（200 筆原始文字）與月度客訴根因分析原則，依原則的步驟歸類、下鑽、找共同根因並排出建議處理優先序。分析訊號類客訴時，請依原則要求交叉比對 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL1_申訴案 底下的網路障礙紀錄。報告要同時呈現「件數排序」與「建議處理優先序」，並說明兩者為何不同。Please run this month's complaint root-cause analysis. Read the monthly complaint detail (200 raw entries) and the root-cause analysis principles in the Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL4_Complaints folder in OneDrive, then classify, drill down, identify common causes and rank the recommended handling priority per those steps. When analysing signal complaints, cross-check the network fault log under Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL1_Complaint as the principles require. The report must show both the volume ranking and the recommended priority ranking, and explain why they differ.
2

⭐ 結論：修一個基站，消除三成客訴⭐ The finding: fix one cell site, remove 30% of complaints

實測把兩百筆歸為六類，訊號類 60 件（30.0%）為最大類。關鍵不在它最大，而在**它 100% 集中在台中西屯、北屯、南屯三區**，且六種資費方案分布完全平均 —— 代表與資費無關，是地域性設備問題。交叉比對網路障礙紀錄後對上了：基站 CT-3312 從 8/10 電壓不穩、8/11 封包遺失率超標（128 戶）一路劣化到 8/13 服務品質劣化（214 戶）。**修一個設備就可能消除三成客訴。**反觀件數第二的帳務爭議 55 件，散落八個縣市、六種方案；客服類 32 件更是八個縣市各四件完全均分 —— 都沒有單一可修的點。它給的一句話很適合當教材金句：**「件數告訴我們哪裡在痛，集中度才告訴我們哪裡值得先開刀。」**The live run grouped the two hundred into six categories, with signal complaints the largest at 60 (30.0%). What matters is not that it is largest but that **100% of them sit in three adjacent districts of Taichung**, spread evenly across all six tariff plans — meaning this is geographic and equipment-driven, not pricing-driven. Cross-checking the fault log confirmed it: cell site CT-3312 degraded from voltage instability on 10 Aug, through packet loss affecting 128 households on 11 Aug, to service degradation affecting 214 on 13 Aug. **One equipment fix could remove thirty percent of the month's complaints.** By contrast the second-largest category, 55 billing disputes, is scattered across eight cities and six plans; the 32 service complaints are distributed exactly four per city — neither has a single point to fix. Its own summary line is worth quoting in class: **"Volume tells us where it hurts; concentration tells us where it is worth operating first."**

3

它多做的三件事，比分析本身更值得看Three things it added — more instructive than the analysis itself

**一、它發現修復後客訴沒有停。** CT-3312 在 8/18 顯示「更換完成／已恢復」，但台中三區在 8/19～8/28 仍有 20 件新客訴（8/18 前為 40 件）。它據此推論「問題可能沒有真正結案，或另有第二個未偵測的劣化點」，並把「回頭複檢」訂為第一優先。這一步沒有人要求它做。**二、它拒絕過度宣稱。** 障礙紀錄只涵蓋西屯，北屯 18 件與南屯 12 件共 30 件找不到對應設備事件，它明確標為「待查」而非結論，並註明需請網路維運部排查。**三、它把推測標示為推測。** 帳務類中有 27 件（該類 49.1%）型態高度相似，但本月資料沒有系統紀錄可佐證，它標明「推測」，須帳務系統稽核後才能認定為單點根因。這三件事共同示範了一件事：**可信的分析，來自它願意說出哪裡不確定。****One: it noticed the complaints did not stop after the repair.** CT-3312 shows "replaced / restored" on 18 Aug, yet the three districts produced 20 further complaints between 19 and 28 Aug (against 40 before the 18th). From that it inferred the issue may not truly be closed, or a second undetected degradation point exists, and made re-inspection the top priority. Nobody asked for this. **Two: it refused to overclaim.** The fault log covers only one of the three districts; the 30 complaints from the other two have no corresponding equipment event, so it marked them "to be investigated" rather than folding them into the conclusion, noting that network operations must check. **Three: it labelled inference as inference.** Within billing, 27 entries (49.1% of that category) share a strikingly similar pattern, but this month's data contains no system records to corroborate it, so it marked the finding speculative pending a billing-system audit. Together these demonstrate one thing: **analysis becomes trustworthy when it is willing to say where it is unsure.**

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

這個情境全程沒有對外動作，因此不會出現核准卡 —— 產出是一份存進 OneDrive 的分析報告。但它有另一層需要把關的地方：**分析結論會影響資源配置**。請帶學員特別檢查三件事：被標為「推測」的部分有沒有被誤讀成結論、被標為「待查」的區域有沒有被當成已確認、以及那個「修復後客訴仍持續」的發現有沒有被追下去。另外，客訴原文含個人陳述，報告中不應出現可識別個人的資訊。There are no outbound actions here, so no approval cards appear — the output is an analysis report saved to OneDrive. But something else needs oversight: **analytical conclusions drive resource allocation**. Have learners check three things specifically: whether anything marked speculative has been read as settled, whether the districts marked "to be investigated" have been treated as confirmed, and whether the "complaints continued after the repair" finding is actually being followed up. Note also that complaints contain personal statements, and the report should carry no personally identifying information.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 兩百筆原始文字被歸納成不超過八個類別，並附件數與佔比The 200 entries are grouped into no more than eight categories with counts and shares
  • 報告同時呈現件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者不同的理由Both the volume ranking and the priority ranking appear, with the reason they differ
  • 最大類別的集中維度有被指出（集中在哪、集中度多少）The largest category's concentration is identified — where it clusters and how tightly
  • 訊號類客訴有與網路障礙紀錄交叉比對，並對上具體設備Signal complaints were cross-checked against the fault log and matched to specific equipment
  • 分散型問題（如帳務、客服）有被明確指出無單點根因Dispersed categories such as billing and service are explicitly identified as having no single root cause
  • 資料涵蓋範圍不足之處被標為「待查」，未被寫成結論Gaps in data coverage are marked for investigation rather than written up as conclusions
  • 無系統紀錄佐證的判斷被明確標示為推測Judgements without corroborating system records are explicitly labelled speculative
  • 報告中未出現可識別個人的資訊The report contains no personally identifying information

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把上個月的客訴一起丟進去，讓它比較兩個月的類別消長。Add last month's complaints and have it compare how the categories shifted.
  • 加入工單系統資料，讓它比對「客訴」與「實際派修」是否對得上。Add work-order data so it can check whether complaints and actual dispatches line up.
  • 把這份分析做成每月自動執行的排程任務，月初自動產出。Turn the analysis into a monthly scheduled task that runs at the start of each month.
🧩
電信業 · 自訂技能Telecom · Custom Skill

SLA 判定技能與技能衝突Building a Skill That Knows When Not to Fire

⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–25 min · Level ★★★

把 TEL2 的 SLA 判定邏輯寫成自訂技能，規則就從「每次要重講」變成「一次寫好、永遠生效」。但技能一多就會出現新問題：**它們會搶同一批請求**。這個情境的重點不是把技能做出來，而是讓它先去比對你既有的技能清單，找出哪些會打架，再把排除條款寫進描述裡。Turning TEL2's SLA logic into a custom skill changes the rules from something you re-explain each time into something written once and always in force. But as skills accumulate a new problem appears: **they compete for the same requests**. The point here is not building the skill — it is having it compare against your existing skills first, find which ones would collide, and write the exclusions into its own description.

會用到的技能Skills used自訂技能 SkillSkill Report

🎯情境背景Scenario

你已經在 TEL2 用過一次 SLA 判定邏輯。問題是那套邏輯目前只活在一次對話裡 —— 換個人、換個月份、換一次對話，全部要重講。寫成技能之後規則有了單一版本、可以分享給同事、改一次全部生效。但如果你的技能資料夾裡已經有十幾個技能，新技能的觸發語很可能和既有的重疊，結果就是該啟動時沒啟動、不該啟動時搶著啟動。You already used this SLA logic once in TEL2. The problem is that it currently lives inside a single conversation — a different colleague, a different month, a new conversation, and it all has to be explained again. As a skill it gains a single version, becomes shareable, and one edit takes effect everywhere. But if your skills folder already holds a dozen or more, the new skill's trigger phrases will likely overlap with existing ones — so it fails to fire when it should, and fires when it should not.

🧰課前環境準備Pre-class setup

  • 📎TEL5_SKILL.mdTEL5_SKILL_EN.md課後對照用的參考答案：含 frontmatter、排除條款、輸出格式與防護欄The reference answer for post-class comparison: frontmatter, exclusions, output format and guardrails
  • 📎TEL5_技能衝突對照表.mdTEL5_技能衝突對照表.md三個技能重疊區的對照表、寫排除條款的三個原則與驗收方式A comparison of three overlapping skills, three principles for writing exclusions, and how to verify them
  • 📎TEL2_SLA月結與違約金計算規則.mdTEL2_SLA月結與違約金計算規則.md技能要寫進去的來源規則（沿用 TEL2 的計算規則）The source rules the skill encodes (reusing TEL2's calculation rules)

⚠️ 這些不是上課時拖進聊天框的附件，而是課前就要放進 OneDrive 與信箱的既有資料。進階情境示範的正是 Cowork 自己去撈、自己跨 App 執行；素材若靠人貼進對話，就退回成 Copilot Chat 也做得到的事了。完整步驟見離線包的〈課前環境準備指南〉。⚠️ These are not chat attachments. They are existing data that must be seeded into OneDrive and the mailbox before class. The advanced scenarios demonstrate Cowork finding the material itself and acting across apps; if a human pastes it into the conversation, it collapses back into something Copilot Chat can already do. See the pre-class setup guide in the offline pack for the full procedure.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

在寫描述之前，先請它比對既有技能Before writing the description, have it compare against existing skills

提示詞裡有一句話決定了這個情境的成敗：「在寫描述之前，請先比對我現有的技能清單，找出可能會跟這個技能搶觸發的技能，並在描述裡寫進明確的 Do NOT use for 排除條款、指名該由哪個技能接手。」沒有這句話，它會寫出一個看起來很好、但會和既有技能打架的描述。⚠️ 這一步會跳出「複製檔案」核准卡（把技能從暫存資料夾複製到正式的 skills 資料夾），**必須手動按下核准，技能才會真的發布**。很多人以為它會自己跑完，結果技能根本沒建立成功。One sentence in the prompt decides whether this scenario works: "before writing the description, compare against my existing skills, identify which would compete for the same requests, and write explicit Do NOT use for exclusions naming the skill that should take them instead." Without it you get a description that reads well and collides with what you already have. ⚠️ This step raises a "copy files" approval card, moving the skill from a temporary folder into the real skills folder — **the skill is only published once you approve it manually**. Many people assume it completes on its own and end up with no skill at all.

提示詞Prompt
我想建立一個自訂技能：企業專線 SLA 違約金判定。當我提供企業專線月度中斷資料並要求判定 SLA、計算違約金或草擬賠償通知時就使用它。規則請依 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL2_企業專線 底下的 SLA 月結與違約金計算規則撰寫，特別是「實際中斷時數＝總中斷−計畫性維護」這條。在寫描述之前，請先比對我現有的技能清單，找出可能會跟這個技能搶觸發的技能，並在描述裡寫進明確的 Do NOT use for 排除條款、指名該由哪個技能接手。另外請加上防護欄：涉及對外承諾金額，一律逐封確認、不可批次核准；資料缺漏標示待確認不可自行編造。I want to create a custom skill: enterprise leased-line SLA credit assessment. It should fire when I supply monthly outage data and ask to assess the SLA, calculate credits or draft compensation notices. Base the rules on the SLA settlement document under Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL2_Leased_Lines in OneDrive, especially the line that actual outage equals total outage minus planned maintenance. Before writing the description, compare against my existing skills, identify which would compete for the same requests, and write explicit Do NOT use for exclusions naming the skill that should take them instead. Add guardrails too: because this commits money externally, always confirm each notice individually and never request bulk approval; mark missing data as unconfirmed and never invent figures.
2

⭐ 它找出六個會搶觸發的技能，並各自指名接手⭐ Six competing skills identified, each handed off by name

這是本情境最有價值的產出。實測比對了 18 個既有技能，找出六個重疊：停線判定技能（都在做「中斷／停機」分級）、月報技能（「月結／月報」字面重疊）、客戶月報與客戶週報（都是對外客戶文件）、利害關係人溝通技能（都會「草擬對外通知信」）、以及試算表技能（都在處理中斷數據）。每一個都寫進 `Do NOT use for … → use X instead` 的委派條款，最後衝突掃描顯示 **0 件未解衝突**。請注意「指名接手」這個細節：只寫「不處理生產停線」會讓請求無人接手，要寫「→ 改用停線判定技能」才形成明確委派。**排除條款不是把門關上，是把人帶到對的門前。**This is the most valuable output of the scenario. The live run compared against 18 existing skills and found six overlaps: a line-stop triage skill (both grade outages), a monthly operations report skill (the words "monthly settlement" collide), client monthly and weekly report skills (both produce outward-facing customer documents), a stakeholder communications skill (both draft outbound notices), and a spreadsheet skill (both work on outage data). Each became a `Do NOT use for … → use X instead` handoff clause, and the final conflict scan reported **zero unresolved conflicts**. Note the naming detail: writing only "does not handle production line stops" leaves the request with nowhere to go; writing "→ use the line-stop triage skill instead" creates an actual handoff. **An exclusion clause is not about closing a door; it is about pointing at the right one.**

3

技能報告：分數不是評語，是可以拆解的診斷The Skill Report: not a verdict but a diagnosis you can take apart

技能建立、更新或驗證時，Cowork 會**自動**回傳一份技能報告：0～100 分，四個各 25 分的面向 —— 觸發清晰度、指示明確度、範圍界線、穩健度。85 分以上 Excellent、70–84 Good、50–69 Needs work、50 以下 Poor。本情境實測拿到 **89 分（Excellent）**。⭐ 但更值得講的是它中間發生的事：初評時穩健度偏低，它自己去查了評分的判斷方式，發現**評分會比對 never／always／confirm 這類英文語彙**，而它原本的防護欄全部寫成中文，因此匹配不到。補上英文語彙後重評，分數才上來 —— 技能的實際行為一個字都沒改。**中文技能作者請記住這件事：防護條款裡保留英文語彙，否則你寫得再嚴謹，分數也會低估它。**Whenever a skill is created, updated or validated, Cowork returns a Skill Report automatically: 0 to 100 across four dimensions worth 25 each — trigger clarity, instruction specificity, scope boundaries and robustness. Excellent at 85+, Good 70-84, Needs work 50-69, Poor below 50. This scenario scored **89 (Excellent)**. ⭐ What happened along the way matters more. The initial robustness score came out low, so it went and checked how that dimension is assessed and found that **the scoring matches on English vocabulary such as never, always and confirm**, while its guardrails had been written entirely in Chinese and therefore matched nothing. Adding the English phrasing lifted the score — without changing a single thing about how the skill behaves. **If you write skills in Chinese, keep English vocabulary in the guardrail clauses, or a rigorously written skill will still be underscored.**

4

用真實資料驗證：宏遠改判、凱鈺照賠Verify with real data: one reclassified, one still liable

技能寫完不等於有效。請拿 TEL2 那份資料實跑一次，重點確認兩個最容易錯的案例有沒有被正確處理。實測八家判定全對，而且它自己算出誤判成本：宏遠科技若直接用總中斷 5.2 小時判定，會誤賠 168,000 × 5% = **8,400 元**。凱鈺網通則因可用率 99.47% 低於門檻而正確判為要賠，雖然實際中斷 3.8 小時未達 4 小時。它還主動指出八家都沒有「改善措施」欄位，只能標待確認，不自行填寫 —— 防護欄確實生效了。A written skill is not a working skill. Run it against the TEL2 data and check the two cases most likely to go wrong. All eight verdicts were correct, and it computed the cost of the error itself: judging Hongyuan on its raw 5.2 outage hours would have paid out 168,000 × 5% = **8,400** in error. Kaiyu was correctly held liable on availability at 99.47%, despite its 3.8 actual outage hours falling short of the four-hour threshold. It also pointed out that none of the eight records contains a remediation field, so that section can only be marked unconfirmed rather than filled in — the guardrail doing its job.

提示詞Prompt
請用 TEL2 那份企業專線月度中斷統計實跑一次驗證。重點確認宏遠科技有沒有因為扣除計畫性維護而正確改判為不賠，以及凱鈺網通有沒有因為可用率而正確判為要賠。Please run a verification pass against the TEL2 monthly outage statistics. Focus on whether Hongyuan is correctly cleared once planned maintenance is deducted, and whether Kaiyu is correctly held liable on the availability threshold.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

建立技能本身不會寄出任何東西，但它有一張**最容易被忽略的核准卡**：「複製檔案」—— 沒按核准，技能就不會發布。這一點請務必當場示範一次。另一層責任是官方文件明確寫的：**使用者自建的技能不經 Microsoft 驗證，請仔細檢查輸出**。技能是以指示的形式交給 AI 執行的，所以只安裝你信任來源的技能檔；分享給同事前先自己確認品質，之後每次修改都要回技能詳細頁按「重新分享」。一份寫得不嚴謹的技能，會把錯誤標準化地複製到每一個用它的人身上。Creating a skill sends nothing outbound, but it carries the **most frequently missed approval card**: "copy files" — skip it and the skill is never published. Demonstrate this one live. The other responsibility is stated plainly in the documentation: **skills created by users are not validated by Microsoft — review their output carefully**. A skill runs as instructions to the AI, so install only skills from sources you trust, verify quality yourself before sharing, and after every edit return to the detail page and select Re-share. A sloppily written skill standardizes its errors across everyone who uses it.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • SKILL.md 有 YAML frontmatter，name 與 description 兩個欄位都存在The SKILL.md has YAML frontmatter with both name and description
  • description 裡有明確的觸發語句，不只是功能說明The description contains explicit trigger phrasing, not just a summary of what it does
  • 比對過既有技能清單，找出會搶觸發的技能並列出Existing skills were compared and the competing ones identified and listed
  • 每條排除條款都指名接手的技能，而非只寫「不處理某某」Every exclusion names the skill that should take over, rather than only stating what is out of scope
  • 衝突掃描結果為 0 件未解衝突The conflict scan reports zero unresolved conflicts
  • 「複製檔案」核准卡已按下核准，技能確實出現在技能清單中The "copy files" approval card was approved and the skill appears in the skills list
  • ⭐ 防護條款含英文語彙（never／always／confirm 等），分數未被低估⭐ Guardrail clauses include English vocabulary so the robustness score is not understated
  • 拿真實資料實跑驗證，兩個關鍵案例都判定正確A verification run against real data got both critical cases right

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把 TEL1 的申訴時序還原也做成技能，讓兩個技能各司其職。Turn TEL1's timeline reconstruction into a skill as well, so the two divide the work.
  • 故意丟一個模糊請求（例如「幫我處理這個月所有客戶問題」），看它會不會反問澄清。Deliberately send an ambiguous request such as "handle all my customer issues this month" and see whether it asks for clarification.
  • 分享給同事後，請他們用自己的說法測試觸發語寫得夠不夠好。Share it with colleagues and have them test, in their own words, whether the trigger phrasing holds up.
